items.title: 2.7.2 Subshells aur orbitals mein electrons ki taqseem: Aufbau principle (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.7.2, printed pages 34-36.

blocks.text: Kai electrons wale atoms ke orbitals bharne par teen qaide lagoo hain: Aufbau principle, Pauli ka exclusion principle aur Hund ka rule. Aufbau ya building-up principle kehta hai ke atom ke subshells electrons se un ki barhti energy ki tarteeb mein bharte hain. Maqnatisi maidan ki ghair-maujoodgi mein subshell ki energy principal quantum number n aur azimuthal quantum number l par munhasir hai, to bharne ki tarteeb n + l ke majmooe se nikalti hai.

blocks.caption: Subshells ke liye n + l ki qeematein (Table 2.6)

items: Kam n + l qeemat wale subshell ki energy kam hai aur woh pehle bharta hai. 4s orbital ka n + l = 4 + 0 = 4 aur 3d ka 3 + 2 = 5, to 4s ki energy kam hai aur woh 3d se pehle bharta hai.
Agar do subshells ki n + l qeematein barabar hon to kam n wala pehle bharta hai. 4p (4 + 1 = 5) aur 3d (3 + 2 = 5) dono ki qeemat 5 hai, aur 3d apne kam n ki wajah se pehle bharta hai.

blocks.text: Is qaide se subshells ki energy ki tarteeb, aur yun bharne ki tarteeb, 1s, 2s, 2p, 3s, 3p, 4s, 3d, 4p, 5s, 4d, 5p, 6s, 4f, 5d, 6p, 7s hai.

blocks.alt: Subshells khanon ki qataaron ki shakal mein, har orbital ka ek khaana, zyada energy wala oopar: neeche se oopar 1s, 2s, 2p, 3s, 3p, 4s, 3d, 4p, 5s, 4d, 5p, 6s, 4f, 5d, 6p, 7s, 5f, 6d, 7p. Baen taraf ka teer orbital bharne ki tarteeb aur us ke saath rangeen teer barhti energy dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Fig 2.12: Diagram har subshell ki energy dikhata hai; har khaana ek atomic orbital hai (kitab ki Fig 2.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Wazahat karein ke potassium mein 4s subshell 3d se pehle kyun bharta hai halanke 3d ka principal quantum number kam hai.
blocks.explanation: Energy n + l par munhasir hai, sirf n par nahi. 4s ka n + l = 4 aur 3d ka 5, to 4s energy mein neeche hai aur pehle bharta hai; is liye potassium ka unniswan electron 4s mein jata hai, jo 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s2 3p6 4s1 deta hai.

items: Aufbau: subshells barhti energy ki tarteeb mein bharte hain, jo n + l se parkhi jati hai (kam pehle; barabar hon to kam n pehle), jo 1s 2s 2p 3s 3p 4s 3d 4p 5s 4d 5p 6s 4f 5d 6p 7s deta hai.
